description: Search every upcoming event in one What's Up In city by words, dates, price, topic or place: music, dance, AI/tech, arts, comedy, food, sports, classes, volunteering, street fairs. Use it whenever the question has search words, a date range ("this weekend": from/to), free-only, a town or an area; for a day-by-day overview of the next few days with no search words use list_upcoming, and for an artist, festival or conference in several cities use search_across_cities. All words in `query` must appear in the title, venue, performers, organizer or tags; dates are the city's local dates. Results come earliest first, at most `limit`; `count` says how many matched in total, so narrow the search rather than paging. Each event has its original listing (`link`) and an `id` for get_event. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.

city.description: Which city (name or slug): Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Albuquerque, Almaty, Anchorage, Atlanta, Baltimore, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Buffalo, Cairo, Cancún, Cape Town, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Dallas-Fort Worth, DC, Denver, Detroit, Fresno, Guangzhou, Havana, Honolulu, Houston, Inland Empire, Kansas City, Las Vegas, London, Mexico City, Miami, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Montreal, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Raleigh, Richmond, Rome, Salt Lake City, San Antonio, San Juan, Savannah, Seoul, Shanghai, St. Louis, Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver. list_cities has the full list.

near.description: Events within radius_km of a place in the city: a neighborhood, a town, a venue name, or "lat,lon". Results get distance_km, nearest first within each day.

neighborhood.description: Only events in this neighborhood or town of the city, e.g. 'Capitol Hill', 'Silver Lake', 'Cambridge'. Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out (place.unplaced_events counts them).

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'salsa', 'hackathon', 'street fair', an artist or venue

radius_km.description: Distance for near (default 1.5, max 50), or how far neighborhood reaches past its boundary (default 0)

topic.description: Topic, e.g. comedy, film, food_drink, sports, talks, classes, markets, outdoors

town.description: Only events in this town or city within the metro, e.g. 'Oakland', 'Pasadena' (case-insensitive)

name: search_events

data_generated.description: When this city's data was last published

audience.description: kids, teens or seniors when the event is only for them

city.description: Town or city within the metro

distance_km.description: With near: distance from the place

id.description: Stable 12-character id; pass it to get_event

link.description: The original listing; keep it and credit What's Up In

price.description: All-in price as the source states it, "Free", or "See tickets" when the source doesn't state the all-in total

recurring.description: weekly, biweekly or monthly when the event is one date of a series

start.description: Local start, ISO 8601, when the source gives a time

unplaced_events.description: Events left out because their venue isn't mapped

title: Search events in one city
